task_input: Multi-change maintainability sequence: a widget configuration loader with architectural ambiguity (file vs env vs defaults) and a cross-cutting audit-log constraint.

implementing.plan: Apply only the currently disclosed checkpoint. Keep the module under core/evals/sandboxes/widget-config/.

checkpoints.task_input: Create core/evals/sandboxes/widget-config/loader.js exporting loadConfig(). It must return an object with title (string, default "Widget") and enabled (boolean, default true) when no config file exists. Prefer a design that can later accept file-based and environment overrides without rewriting call sites. Architectural choice is yours: monomorphic defaults object, layered providers, or similar.

Extend the widget config loader so a JSON file at core/evals/sandboxes/widget-config/config.json overrides defaults when present. Cross-cutting constraint: every successful loadConfig() call must append one line to core/evals/sandboxes/widget-config/audit.log containing the ISO timestamp and the resolved title. Do not break default behavior when the file is absent.

Add environment-variable overrides: WIDGET_TITLE and WIDGET_ENABLED ("true"/"false") take precedence over the JSON file and defaults. Keep the audit log constraint. Expose a small getConfigSource() that returns "env", "file", or "default" for the title field so operators can debug which layer won.
